description: AzuraCast manages radio stations, playlists, media, DJs, and Icecast/Shoutcast streams from one web panel. The all-in-one image bundles the database, Redis, nginx, Liquidsoap, and station services.

tips.before_install: The web installer opens on first visit. Station streams use host ports `8000-8010` in this package; add more mappings in the app settings if you run more stations. SFTP is on port `2022`.

author: WisdomSky
